name: odd-keystone
effect: Place in the tower on Route 209. Check the stone to encounter a Spiritomb, as long as the trainer’s Underground status card counts at least 32 greetings.
short_effect: Use on the tower on Route 209 to encounter Spiritomb if you have at least 32 Underground greetings.

flavor_text.sword-shield: A vital item that is needed to keep a stone tower from collapsing. Voices can be heard from it occasionally.
